reason_for_supersession: User authorized revising the feature timeframe and bar boundaries when a better market-aligned design is supported.

feature_representation_policy.principle: Choose signal-time representation from evidence, actual market hours, and data quality; do not inherit a TradingView label by default.
families_to_compare: TSE session-aligned morning and afternoon bars rebuilt from raw intraday observations
TradingView-compatible 09:00-12:59 and 13:00-to-official-close bins rebuilt from the same raw observations
intraday features reconciled with daily OHLCV where mathematically and temporally valid
daily features as a separate candidate family, never relabeled as intraday
feature_representation_policy.candidate_feature_timestamp: Only completed observations available by the signal timestamp may be used.
feature_representation_policy.legacy_intraday_artifact: Do not use the special legacy ohlcv_4h values as model features and never mutate them. A read-only gap audit on an exported copy is allowed.
feature_representation_policy.fresh_intraday_artifact: Build any intraday panel used for scoring from raw intraday input under a versioned, exchange-aware specification and store it separately in ignored research artifacts.
feature_representation_policy.selection_gate: Freeze feature family and bar definitions before outcomes. Compare identical frozen symbol/session pools and identical endpoint targets.

daily_data_role: Same-symbol/same-session availability and intraday consistency audit
Source reconciliation or a separately tested daily-context feature only when available at signal time

daily_supplement_limits.may_validate: Full-day open/high/low/close/volume aggregated from intraday can be compared with the same-session daily bar after source adjustment semantics are aligned.
daily_supplement_limits.may_replace_when_available: A same-session daily close can serve as the end-of-day close for a signal evaluated after that daily bar is final. Daily open may validate the session open.
daily_supplement_limits.cannot_reconstruct: Daily high/low/close/volume cannot determine which intraday session or time produced an extreme or allocate total volume across morning and afternoon.
daily_supplement_limits.lookahead: Same-day daily high, low, close, and total volume are unavailable to intraday signals before market close; using them earlier leaks future information.
daily_supplement_limits.derived_residual_volume: Daily total minus independently validated complete morning volume may be tested as a separately source-tagged afternoon-volume diagnostic only when both sources share adjustment and coverage semantics and the residual is nonnegative. It must not be reported as observed hourly volume.

target.entry: Open of the next official XTKS business session after the signal date.
target.exit: Close of the fifth official XTKS business session after the signal date, counting the entry session as session one.
target.entry_exit_price_source: Already available daily OHLCV only; no intraday fill price is inferred.
target.signal_time_effect: Morning and afternoon signals on the same session use the same daily entry and exit dates/prices.

endpoint_label.required_prices: Positive finite entry-session open and fifth-session close on exact official session dates.
endpoint_label.intermediate_daily_bars: Not required for endpoint mark-to-market; missing interior sessions remain explicitly path-incomplete.
endpoint_label.volume: Does not erase endpoint mark-to-market; zero or unknown endpoint/interior volume remains an execution-quality diagnostic.
endpoint_label.missing_or_invalid_endpoint: Unresolved status; never forward-fill or skip sessions.

evaluation_scope.unit_tests: Synthetic daily bars, including same-session morning and afternoon signals and missing interior sessions.
evaluation_scope.retrospective_audit: Previously exposed artifacts only; endpoint and strict-path metrics remain separate.
evaluation_scope.feature_choice: Do not tune new bar definitions or feature supplementation on previously viewed 2025/2026 outcomes.

prohibited: Treating a daily-feature model as an intraday model
Treating unequal TSE session bars as equal-duration four-hour bars
Using legacy special-construction ohlcv_4h values as features or overwriting them
Synthesizing missing intraday OHLC from daily OHLCV
Using final daily OHLCV before its market close
Opening 2025/2026 outcomes for new feature selection
External price fetch or account signup as part of this frozen label test
